integrity: The mathematical proof is self-contained. The supplemental Python code checks complete original-state processes at small m, state orbits at larger finite m, and exact constructive witnesses. No independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for all-negative once-subdivided stars with m >= 3; the independent mathematical assessment and exhaustive historical-priority verification are not performed. Finite-state checks do not prove infinitely many cases.
title: Sharp plurality for all-negative once-subdivided stars
